title: Visual follower event
description: Local visual API payload; not a Twitch EventSub envelope or evidence of delivery. Additional properties are ignored. id length uses JavaScript UTF-16 code units (maximum 128), an extra runtime constraint beyond JSON Schema codepoint maxLength.

displayName.description: Original case preserved. 1–64 Unicode codepoints, with at least one non-whitespace character. Rendered as text only.

id.description: Optional exact event ID. Empty string is a valid ID. Last 100 accepted unique IDs are retained until reload.
